WITH ps AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2), cur AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), d AS (SELECT ps.payer_class, cur.payment_date-ps.first_sub dd FROM ps JOIN cur USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE cur.paid_amount>0) SELECT payer_class,count(*),round(median(dd),1),round(quantile_cont(dd,0.9),1) FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), den AS (SELECT remit_claim_id,claim_key,payer_key FROM cur WHERE is_denied), adj AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.carc_code,den.claim_key,den.payer_key FROM den JOIN sem.adjustments a USING(remit_claim_id) WHERE a.group_code='CO' AND a.is_denial_carc) SELECT carc_code,count(*) FROM adj GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1 LIMIT 5

WITH ev AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) pc,count(*) n,bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) good FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT pc,count(*) pairs,count(*) FILTER (WHERE n=1 AND good) fp FROM ev GROUP BY 1) SELECT pc,pairs,fp,round(100.0*fp/pairs,2) FROM r ORDER BY 1

WITH pr AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) pc,count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) t,bool_or(is_reversal) rv,bool_or(is_current_adjudication) c,sum(CASE WHEN is_current_adjudication THEN paid_amount ELSE 0 END) p FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2), m AS (SELECT * FROM pr WHERE t>=2) SELECT pc,count(*),sum(rv::INT),sum((NOT c)::INT),round(sum(p),2) FROM m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
WITH l AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication), p AS (SELECT * FROM l WHERE line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied) SELECT count(*) FROM p

WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key,payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P'), cur AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), pc AS (SELECT remit_claim_id FROM cur JOIN p USING(claim_key,payer_key)), d AS (SELECT adjustment_amount FROM sem.adjustments JOIN pc USING(remit_claim_id) WHERE group_code='PR' AND carc_code='1') SELECT round(coalesce(sum(adjustment_amount),0),2) FROM d

WITH c AS (SELECT service_month m,referring_npi npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month>=DATE '2026-06-01'), cnt AS (SELECT m,npi,count(*) n FROM c GROUP BY 1,2), rk AS (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m ORDER BY n DESC,npi) r FROM cnt), agg AS (SELECT m,sum(n) tot,sum(n) FILTER (WHERE r<=5) t5 FROM rk GROUP BY 1) SELECT strftime(m,'%Y-%m'),tot,t5,round(100.0*t5/tot,1) FROM agg ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), b AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key,payer_key,procedure_code FROM sem.claim_lines WHERE is_latest_submission), x AS (SELECT b.procedure_code,cur.is_denied FROM cur JOIN b USING(claim_key,payer_key)) SELECT procedure_code,count(*),sum(is_denied::INT),sum(is_denied::INT)*1.0/count(*) FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=20 ORDER BY 4 DESC,1

WITH lt AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,line_count,charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND payer_responsibility='P'), cur AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), j AS (SELECT CASE WHEN line_count>=3 THEN '3+' ELSE line_count::VARCHAR END b,lt.charge_amount ch,cur.is_denied d FROM lt JOIN cur USING(claim_key,payer_key)) SELECT b,count(*),sum(d::INT),round(100.0*sum(d::INT)/count(*),2),coalesce(sum(ch) FILTER (WHERE d),0) FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH fb AS (SELECT * FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code='FB'), cf AS (SELECT * FROM fb WHERE provider_adjustment_amount<0), m AS (SELECT cf.provider_adjustment_id,min(o.payment_date) od FROM cf JOIN fb o ON o.payer_key=cf.payer_key AND o.reference_id=cf.reference_id AND o.provider_adjustment_amount=-cf.provider_adjustment_amount AND o.payment_date>cf.payment_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT cf.reference_id,cf.payment_date,round(-cf.provider_adjustment_amount,2),m.od,m.od-cf.payment_date FROM cf LEFT JOIN m USING(provider_adjustment_id) ORDER BY 2,1

WITH cur AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), mp AS (SELECT payer_class,payment_month m,sum(paid_amount) p FROM cur WHERE payment_month IN (DATE '2026-07-01',DATE '2026-08-01') GROUP BY 1,2), cls AS (SELECT DISTINCT payer_class FROM mp), s AS (SELECT c.payer_class,100*j.p/sum(j.p) OVER () js,100*a.p/sum(a.p) OVER () as_ FROM cls c LEFT JOIN mp j ON j.payer_class=c.payer_class AND j.m='2026-07-01' LEFT JOIN mp a ON a.payer_class=c.payer_class AND a.m='2026-08-01') SELECT payer_class,round(js,1),round(as_,1),round(as_-js,1) FROM s ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,min(submission_date) FILTER (WHERE frequency_code='1') o,min(submission_date) FILTER (WHERE frequency_code='7') r FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2), c AS (SELECT * FROM s WHERE r IS NOT NULL), cur AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), a AS (SELECT c.*,cur.payment_date pd,cur.paid_amount pa FROM c JOIN cur USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE cur.payment_date>=c.r) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM c),(SELECT round(avg(r-o),2) FROM c),count(*),round(avg(pd-o),2),coalesce(sum(pa),0) FROM a

WITH v AS (SELECT claim_key,min(submission_date) vd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='8' GROUP BY 1), e AS (SELECT v.claim_key,bool_or(r.paid_amount>0 AND r.payment_date<v.vd) pb,bool_or(r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date>=v.vd) rv,sum(r.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE r.is_current_adjudication) cp FROM v LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key) GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE pb),count(*) FILTER (WHERE rv),round(coalesce(sum(cp),0),2) FROM e

WITH co AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) repl FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2), f AS (SELECT co.payer_class,co.claim_key,min(r.payment_date)-co.repl d FROM co JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE r.payment_date>=co.repl GROUP BY co.payer_class,co.claim_key,co.payer_key,co.repl) SELECT payer_class,count(*),round(avg(d),1),min(d),max(d) FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH ps AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2), coh AS (SELECT * FROM ps WHERE first_sub BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'), fr AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,min(payment_date) f FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2), j AS (SELECT coh.payer_class,fr.f-coh.first_sub d FROM coh LEFT JOIN fr USING(claim_key,payer_key)) SELECT payer_class,count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE d<=14),round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE d<=14)/count(*),1) FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH co AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) repl FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2), dn AS (SELECT DISTINCT co.claim_key,co.payer_key,co.repl FROM co JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE r.claim_status_code='4' AND r.payment_date<co.repl), af AS (SELECT DISTINCT dn.claim_key,dn.payer_key FROM dn JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE r.payment_date>=dn.repl), cur AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), o AS (SELECT CASE WHEN af.claim_key IS NULL THEN 'no remit since correction' WHEN cur.is_denied=false THEN 'overturned' ELSE 'denied again' END oc,coalesce(cur.paid_amount,0) p FROM dn LEFT JOIN af USING(claim_key,payer_key) LEFT JOIN cur USING(claim_key,payer_key)) SELECT oc,count(*),round(sum(p),2) FROM o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sd AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key,payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE adjudication_state='superseded' AND is_denied), cur AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), ov AS (SELECT cur.* FROM cur JOIN sd USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE NOT cur.is_denied) SELECT count(*),coalesce(round(sum(paid_amount),2),0) FROM ov

WITH ps AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2), lt AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,frequency_code,charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' AND is_latest_submission), cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key,payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), op AS (SELECT ps.*,lt.charge_amount,DATE '2026-08-14'-ps.first_sub age FROM ps JOIN lt USING(claim_key,payer_key) ANTI JOIN cu USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE lt.frequency_code<>'8') SELECT CASE WHEN age<=14 THEN '0-14' WHEN age<=29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END,count(*),sum(charge_amount) FROM op GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
